messages:
nina: Heads-up: scheduling the header-gate swap at 01:00 UTC in the change window. Affects router, api, runtime, and console feature-flag. Need to confirm pins and rollback lanes now.
sam: ack. API change is non-breaking by default; new header `x-rw-experiment` opt-in. We'll start at 5% traffic.
lee: runtime needs a config flip for `kv.eviction.strategy=adaptive`. That's stateful on runtime nodes; prefer to stagger.
aditya: console will only flip the visual toggle after router reaches 100%. I can keep the UI flag in "canary" state.
deploy-bot: @channel plan prepped. Pins: router@sha:fa1b2c -> header-proxy-enabled, api@sha:ab9d00 -> v2.4.0, runtime@sha:cc77ee -> kv-adaptive, console@sha:dd88ff -> ui-flag-canary. Canary targets: 6 routers, 3 api pods, 2 runtime nodes.
nina: rollback lanes: 1) if 5xx or routing errors, revert router route to previous variant. 2) if API errors persist, pin-api->previous. 3) runtime unpin is last; it restarts nodes and can cause cache churn.
lee: runtime restart time ~2.5m; add `drain_timeout=75s` to ensure graceful shutdown. Also ensure autoscaler holds desired capacity during restarts.
aditya: console rollback is immediate. I'll stand by at T+10m to flip back.
sam: SLO triggers: >1.0% 5xx sustained 3m OR p95 latency increase >50% sustained 2m OR host memory >80% for 3m. Any of those -> immediate rollback signal.
opsbot: Alert "header-gate-window" created with thresholds above. Pager: infra-oncall.
deploy-bot: Kickoff: canary wave 1 starting in us-central at T+4m. Command run: ```deploy-bot roll --wave=canary1 --variants router@fa1b2c api@ab9d00 runtime@cc77ee```
lee: preflight logs look clean. Eviction delta +2% (expected).
aditya: console stays in canary mode. I will not expose toggle.
sam: note for release notes: add migration note that the header is opt-in; older clients unaffected. Also include rollback runbook link: https://go/release-runbooks/header-gate
lee: if eviction >10% we should abort and pin runtime back: `kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=runtime:prev-sha` and scale nodes temporarily.
deploy-bot: Canary wave 1 success. No 5xx spikes. p95 +6%. Proceeding to wave 2 (ramp to 25%).
aditya: holding console toggle until we hit >=70% routing.
nina: starting wave 2 now. Keep monitoring traces and cache metrics.
opsbot: Metric snapshot at T+9m: 5xx 0.12%, p95 +9%, memory host avg 58%. No alerts.
sam: good. If wave 2 remains green we'll do final ramp and then console flip. Keep comms in this thread and publish final rollout note after completion. :thumbsup:
